notes.title: Update Notes for 18th October 2022
notes.content: Fixed error that prevented World 2 Level 9 loading.  Sorry about that folks!

notes.title: Update notes for 17 October
notes.content:
Bug-Fixes

[list]
[*] "Insufficient Gold" erroneously showed when missions were free (because you had previously completed them) but you wouldn't have had enough gold if they weren't free.
[*] World 2 Level 2 Mission 2 -  You now do have 120 seconds to complete the level as stated
[*] Game Settings Screen - Navigating between buttons with controller now works properly
[/list]
